summary: V2X, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a secondary offering of 2,004,569 shares of common stock by a selling shareholder at a public offering price of $74.35 per share, with underwriter Morgan Stanley purchasing at $73.91 per share. The company receives no proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation event. No special-situation triggers are present.
